Nora Patel: Heads up 1: nightly invoice run created INV-2026-01123 with totals that don't add up. The PDF shows a rounding adjustment of -$0.01 and a vendor rebate duplicated, resulting in a $0 balance but ledger shows money owed.
Samir Kaur: Can you dump the generated JSON and the ledger entry?
Nora Patel: Generator output: ```{\"id\":\"INV-2026-01123\",\"customer\":\"PaperTrail Inc\",\"lines\":[{\"desc\":\"subscription (May)\",\"amount_cents\":950000},{\"desc\":\"vendor rebate\",\"amount_cents\":-50000},{\"desc\":\"vendor rebate\",\"amount_cents\":-50000},{\"desc\":\"rounding adj\",\"amount_cents\":-1},{\"desc\":\"tax\",\"amount_cents\":15000}],\"total_cents\":85000}```
Jared Bloom: So two identical rebate lines. Was rebate applied twice during rebate-sync retry?
Billing Bot: rebate-sync-worker: completed job rs-20260502-44 at 2026-05-02T03:05:12Z; wrote rebate record rbt-902 to kv-store. ops-worker: retry observed transient 503 at 2026-05-02T03:05:09Z.
Ops Bot: ledger-service: created invoice record INV-2026-01123 status=issued at 2026-05-02T03:06:00Z; ledger entry id=LED-7783; amount_cents=85000.
Samir Kaur: Wait ledger shows 85,000 cents, generator total shows 85,000 cents, but PDF preview was $0?
Nora Patel: PDF renderer log: renderer-3: subtotal calc mismatch: expected 950000-100000+15000-1 = 865000 but displayed 0 due to null subtotal fallback. rendering error: \"subtotal is null\".
Jared Bloom: Looks like two problems: duplicate rebate write and renderer bailout when subtotal missing. Immediate action: pause rebate-sync, mark ledger as source-of-truth, do not email PDF, and regenerate invoice after dedupe. Need finance lead approval to mutate ledger if we void.
Samir Kaur: Approve ledger correction + regenerate. Proceed. :white_check_mark:
Nora Patel: Commands run: `opsctl worker pause rebate-sync-worker` ; `billing-cli invoice reconcile --id INV-2026-01123 --dedupe-lines --force` ; `billing-cli invoice regenerate --id INV-2026-01123 --force`
Billing Bot: reconcile output: `{\"id\":\"INV-2026-01123\",\"action\":\"deduped 1 rebate line\",\"new_total_cents\":865000}`
Billing Bot: regen output: `{\"id\":\"INV-2026-01123\",\"lines\":[{\"desc\":\"subscription (May)\",\"amount_cents\":950000},{\"desc\":\"vendor rebate\",\"amount_cents\":-50000},{\"desc\":\"tax\",\"amount_cents\":15000},{\"desc\":\"rounding adj\",\"amount_cents\":-1}],\"total_cents\":865000}`
Jared Bloom: Filed ENG-5467: "Duplicate vendor rebate and renderer null-subtotal bailout" with repro steps and logs; assigned to eng-billing and eng-rendering. Set severity P1 for invoice correctness.
Samir Kaur: Notifying vendor ops and support to hold any communications until confirmed.
Nora Patel: Will monitor for other affected customers in tonight's run and follow-up if more duplicates appear. Closing thread for now.
